candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Italian modifier and determiner words such as pronouns, adjectives, and adverbs.
This vector represents medical conditions, pathogens, and associated healthcare concepts.
This vector represents common scientific and medical root words, prefixes, and chemical or biological terminology.
This vector represents prefixes, roots, and capitalized words related to organs, musical instruments, and biological or anatomical terms.
This vector represents Italian lexical roots, grammatical particles, and common morphological endings frequently occurring in Italian text corpora.
This feature vector activates on medical, anatomical, and pathological root words and prefixes.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens starting with the letter sequence "ass" or containing variations of the word "association" and related prefixes.
This vector represents sequential numeric values around 180.
This feature vector represents common acronyms and initialisms for organizations, medical conditions, media brands, and formats.
This feature vector represents morphological stems and roots frequently found in medical and biological terminology across Romance and English languages.
